# Data Quality

This folder covers the integrity, completeness, and accuracy of records within the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (Acute Surgery Database). It documents specific data quality challenges that impact the reliability of clinical indicators, including patient exclusions due to invalid CPR numbers, missing numerator and denominator fields that render mortality statistics uninterpretable, and significant regional disparities in data completeness. Furthermore, it highlights structural inconsistencies between aggregated national figures and detailed patient-level records, underscoring the ongoing need for rigorous validation protocols in clinical registries.

## Pages

- [[data-quality|Data Quality]] — Details specific data inconsistencies, missing fields, and regional disparities affecting the reliability of clinical indicators in the acute surgery database.
